resources.string: Nothing-inspired home-screen gallery, adapted from the MIT AwesomeAWidgets author renderer and the MIT KWGT-Widgets author presets.
Add buttons pin that widget directly below its preview. Ready items are functional now; pending, blocked and unavailable items are labeled with the exact remaining work.

This Android version does not need Alarms & reminders access for minute updates.

The dotted clock is a bitmap refreshed about once a minute by an exact alarm. Android requires you to grant Alarms & reminders access for that refresh; Dotwel never grants it for you.\n\nWithout access, Add Clock still places a working plain live system TextClock. Dotted time is not shown and is not pretended to be live.

The styled analog bitmap redraws about once a minute with the same optional Alarms & reminders access. Without it, the placed widget shows the platform live analog clock instead. No access is granted by the app.

Alarms & reminders access is enabled. Placed clocks draw the circular-dot bitmap and refresh about once a minute. Deep idle can delay an update.

Tap to open the Alarms and reminders settings for this app in Android; the app never grants access itself. You can revoke it at any time. Android cancels updates for this app when access is revoked, so a placed clock falls back to the live system text clock on its next update or resize. Updates are best-effort: deep idle or Doze can delay them.

Your launcher did not open a placement prompt. You can add the widget manually:

1. Go to your home screen.
2. Long-press an empty area.
3. Tap Widgets.
4. Choose Dotwel Widgets.
5. Pick the widget you want.

No Alarms & reminders access is needed to place a widget.

Use each gallery card\'s Add button. If your launcher does not show a placement prompt, long-press an empty area of the home screen, open Widgets, choose Dotwel Widgets, then pick a widget. Resize placed widgets from their handles. Style changes apply to every placed widget.

Clocks adapted from the MIT AwesomeAWidgets author code; the Nothing Battery card is converted from the MIT KWGT-Widgets author preset. Original circular-dot glyphs and Android platform serif/condensed fonts substitute the upstream fonts. Not affiliated with Nothing Technology Limited.

A live stacked-hours-and-minutes clock. The dotted bitmap updates about once a minute when Alarms & reminders access is enabled; deep idle can delay an update. Otherwise the system text clock is shown.
A live serif date with a red abbreviated weekday and black, translucent or transparent styling.
A bold circular analog clock using the upstream-derived palette, with a live platform analog clock fallback when minute updates are not available.
A slim analog clock with a full minute tick scale, with a live platform analog clock fallback when minute updates are not available.
Two configurable time zones with the translated NtWorld row composition.
A daily quote from the AwesomeAWidgets author data file; tap to advance.
A circular battery gauge translated from the KWGT Nothing_Battery preset. The level comes from the system battery state; tap opens power settings where supported.
Stacked hour and minute dots: upstream NtDigital fit and centre composition with Dotwel\'s original dot glyphs.
Day number and abbreviated red weekday using the translated NtDate fitting and baseline geometry.
NtAnalogBold provider wiring, redrawn as an original programmatic dial and bold hands because the upstream hand artwork is not bundled.
NtAnalogScale provider wiring with a sixty-tick scale, redrawn without the upstream dial/hand drawables.
NtWorld two-row world clock with per-widget zone choice before the native pin request.
NtQuotes layout with the upstream assets/nt_quotes.csv author data; tap cycles the daily offset.
KWGT Nothing_Battery layer geometry and level formula converted to a native provider: side/2 circle, level*3.6 arc and the author cm(215,g,b) colour, with Dotwel dot glyphs in place of ndot-47.ttf.
